verdict.rationale: Claude's marketing page lists "Hand off and schedule tasks", and the help center mentions "long-running tasks". Both point to a first-party capability for delegated, scheduled work, but each is a single headline-level mention with no detail on how automations are configured, triggered or run. The evidence does not show that scheduling is recurring rather than one-off, or that tasks run autonomously in the background without the user present. missing for 10: documentation of automation setup and triggers, evidence of recurring schedules versus one-off hand-offs, confirmation of unattended background execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Collaborate with Claude on shared workspaces and long-running tasks.
